description: This file constitutes a detailed, markdown-formatted Low-Level Design (LLD) document describing the Leads module in the vtiger CRM system. It outlines the module's structure, core classes, database schema, workflows, and key interactions, serving as a comprehensive technical reference.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Base class providing persistence, event triggers, and relationship management for CRM modules. Responsible for CRUD operations, relation handling, and event invocation for entities like Leads.

classes.name: Leads
classes.description: Represents the Leads module entity, manages database tables, data retrieval, related lists, and custom behavior specific to Leads, such as relation management, export queries, and related record transfer during merge or conversion.

classes.name: ConvertLeadUI
classes.description: Helper class for rendering and managing the Lead Conversion UI, loading lead data, setting ownership info, and mapping fields based on pre-defined conversions and permissions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an instance of the Leads module for persistence and operations.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Loads entity data from database into the CRMEntity object based on record ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Triggers the save process, managing database transactions, event triggers, and metadata updates.

methods.name: saveentity
methods.description: Performs the actual persistence into database tables; invoked within save().

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query to export lead data with permission and filter considerations.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Fetches related activities and events for the lead.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves activity history for the lead.

methods.name: get_campaigns
methods.description: Returns campaigns associated with the lead.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records (activities, notes, products, campaigns) during merge or conversion processes.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes a relationship link between the lead and another entity/module.

methods.name: save_related_module
methods.description: Adds relation entries between the lead and other modules/entities.
